Enterprise Azure DevSecOps Capstone demonstrating a production-style CI/CD pipeline using Azure DevOps, Docker, Azure Container Registry (ACR), Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Kubernetes, SonarCloud, Trivy, and Azure Monitor.
Real-world DevOps project focused on reducing Docker build time, image size, and deployment latency for organizations deploying 20–30 applications daily.

Python For DevOps [AI Edition] is a hands-on, beginner-friendly live course that teaches you the exact Python skills needed to automate real DevOps workflows, build tools, integrate with cloud services, and apply AI in day-to-day engineering tasks.
